project: Tractor Mania is very addictive game! You play as a tractor driver, your goal is to deliver items from the warehouse to the factory. The more items you bring, the more coins you get. For coins, you can buy new tractors and trailers in your garage, as well as improve them. Show everyone who is the best transporter!
